paite: Israelte chingpa, Belamhon bang Joseppipa bil na doh in; nang cherubte kal a tu, hong vakkhia in.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Nam Tundingna Dia Thumna

paite: Ephraim leh Benjamin, Manasseh mitmuh in na hatna tokthou inla, hon hondam ding in hong pai in.
Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, bang tan ahia na mite thumna tung a na heh ding?
Amaute khitui tanghou in na vak a, khitui dawn ding in tehna liantak in na pe zel hi.
Nang ka kim ua mite a ding in kinakna ding in na hon bawl nak a, ka melmate uh anui chiat nak uhi.
Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
Aigupta gam a kipan grepgui na hon la a; namte na delhkhia a, na suanta hi.
Ama na hihsiang zel a, thutak in zung akai a, gam aluah vek hi.
Mualte aliim tuam in a-om chiat a, ahiangte Pathian sidar singte bang ahi.
Ahiangte tuipi tan in azamsuaksak a aselte Luipi pha in.
Bang achia ahuangte hihsia na hia? Lampi a pai peuhmah in agah alohtheihna ding un.
Gamnuai a ngal in ahihsia a, gamsate'n leng ane uhi.
Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hehpih in kihei nawn in; van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, hiai grepgui en inla, hong veh in.
Akung na khut taklam in asuanleh, ahiang nang dia na khauhsak toh.
Mei ah akangta, phuk in a-omta; na mel asalhna ziak in amangthang zel hi.
Na taklam a mi tung ah na khut om hen, mihing tapa nang dia na hihhat tung ah.
Huchi in ka hon kiksan kei ding ua; hon hihhalh inla, na min ka lou ding uhi.
TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
